info.title: Slimlytics API
info.description:
Account, personal API token, site configuration, privacy-preserving collection, reporting, goals, export, and real-time APIs for Slimlytics.

Use a short-lived session JWT for creating personal API tokens. Use a `slyt_…` personal API token for durable CLI and agent access. Both use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Collection write keys authorize ingestion only.
